quests.title: The Silent Wood
text: Sister Wren wants to know what's wrong with the forest. Go to the forest's edge after dusk and wait out one night.
No fairies dance. The butterflies are gone. And something has scored the bark of the oldest tree.

tasks.title: Go to the forest
Wait at the forest's edge after dark

quests.title: A Shrine for the Quiet
text: Sister Wren asks for a small wayside shrine: mossy stone, candles, and wildflowers gathered from three different places.
Build it wherever feels right.

tasks.title: Build the wayside shrine

quests.title: Somewhere to Come Back To
text: You can't sleep in a sleeping bag forever. Build your first home near Reece, with a bed, a chest, a table and chairs.

tasks.title: Build your home: a bed, a chest and a door of your own

quests.title: The Fallen Adventurer
text: Out in the wild lie the remains of adventurers who never came home, still in their rusted gear.
Find one. Something in the forest's silence points that way.

tasks.title: Find a fallen adventurer

quests.title: What the Dark Keeps
text: The adventurer's journal speaks of 'the wardens growing weak', and points to an old dungeon.
Clear a dungeon, and find the second journal page on one of its guardians.

tasks.title: Find the dungeon

quests.title: Word to the Neighbours
text: Sister Wren writes to the cleric of the next village along the road. Deliver her letter in person; his reply will follow you home by post.

lines: A letter from Sister Wren? It's been too long.
Tell her I'll write back. The post's slow, but it gets there.
tasks.title: Deliver the letter to another village's cleric

quests.title: The First Wardens
text: Both journal pages together tell of guardians: the wardens, who hold the old places shut.
Sister Wren has read them twice.

lines: The wardens hold the old places shut, and something is draining them.
The first sleeps in iron under the hills. Take this blessed armour.

quests.title: Iron and Edge
text: Arm yourself for what's ahead: a proper weapon, a shield and full iron armour.
Any Spartan Weaponry iron weapon will do; the quest asks for a longsword, but the choice is yours.

quests.title: Sand and Vine
text: Search a desert or jungle temple. Get past its traps to the inner chamber, where a mural shows a hooded iron giant.

tasks.title: Reach a temple's inner chamber

item.name: Temple Tablet
item.tooltip: A carved tablet: a hooded iron giant

search.found: Among the offerings lies a carved tablet: a hooded giant of iron.

tasks.title: Find what the temple remembers of the iron giant

quests.title: The Echo in the Shaft
text: Miners in an old mineshaft heard metal footsteps below them. Explore it, mine 16 iron, and look for scrape marks leading down.

tasks.title: Explore a mineshaft

quests.title: Strike From Behind
text: Armour that breathes, in a sealed chamber. Captain Hale of the Village watch knows what that means, and wants you ready before you go anywhere near it.

lines: Iron giants turn slowly. Get behind it and strike.
Practise on a dummy. Look first, fight later. And come back.

quests.title: The Iron Door
text: Follow the scrape marks to a Wrought Chamber and look at its sealed door. The armour inside is breathing.

tasks.title: Find a Wrought Chamber

quests.title: The Ferrous Wroughtnaut
text: Wake the Ferrous Wroughtnaut and beat it. Dodge its axe and strike its exposed back, like Hale taught you.

tasks.title: Put the iron giant back to sleep

quests.title: Rust on the Seal
text: Take what you learned back to Sister Wren.

lines: You're alive. It wasn't evil. It was starving.
Something fed on it for years. It's all of the wardens.

quests.title: A Priest on the Road
text: On the road, a travelling priest of the Arcane order stops you. He's been following the same trail.

encounter.name: Travelling Priest
lines: The drain smells of old magic. Try the Pyromancer Tower.
Its keepers know more than they say.

quests.title: Banners on the Hill
text: Pillagers have raised an outpost near the trade road. Clear it and take down its captain.

tasks.title: Find the outpost
Clear the outpost off the trade road

quests.title: Frost on the Wind
text: A frightened trader comes looking for help: something froze his caravan in the snowy taiga.

encounter.name: Frightened Trader
lines: Ice, in a heartbeat. My caravan is frozen in the taiga.
Stop it before it finds a village.

quests.title: Four of Him
text: An Illusioner haunts the woods. Find the real one among its copies and defeat it.

quests.title: The Long Night
text: Captain Hale has a plan: draw the raiders out on your terms. Carry the Bad Omen into a village and hold it through a full raid.

lines: We fight at the village edge. Nobody gets near the fields.
...Marta's fields. All the farms, equally. Bring the omen.

quests.title: Masks in the Grass
text: Travel to the savanna and find the Umvuthana Grove. Watch the Umvuthana from cover and count their masks.

tasks.title: Find the grove
Watch an Umvuthana

quests.title: Umvuthi, the Sunbird
text: Face Umvuthi and its followers in the heart of the grove. Break the circle of masks before the sun spell lands.

tasks.title: Break the circle of masks

quests.title: A Door in the Flowers
text: With two wardens freed, Sister Wren remembers the spirits' own realm.
Dig a pool, ring it with flowers and drop a diamond in. The way into the Twilight Forest opens.

tasks.title: Enter the Twilight Forest

quests.title: Where the Spirits Went
text: Step through into the Twilight Forest and find its quest grove. The forest spirits Notch set to guard the woods fled here, and they know what is draining the wardens.

tasks.title: Step into the Twilight Forest
Find the quest grove where the spirits hide

encounter.name: Forest Spirit
lines: We hid. Something rises from below, hungry.
It drains the wardens, one by one.

tasks.title: Hear the hiding spirits

quests.title: The Twilight Calls (Part 1)
text: The spirits ask you to lift the first curses on their forest: the Naga in its courtyard, and the Lich in its tower. The Twilight Forest questline holds the rest of this realm.

tasks.title: Defeat the Naga coiled in its courtyard
Defeat the Lich in its tower

quests.title: Ice Where None Should Be
text: Reece's shepherd lost a flock to a white beast in the snowy hills. The spirits name it Frostmaw, a warden of winter woken too early.

lines: A white beast took my flock. Tracks like pits in the snow.
The spirits call it Frostmaw. Find it before winter does.
tasks.title: Hear the shepherd's loss

quests.title: Tracks in the Snow
text: Follow broken ice and frozen carcasses across the snow to where Frostmaw sleeps, and leave a ring of lit campfires at its den so it cannot freeze you.

tasks.title: Follow the frozen carcasses into the snow
Find Frostmaw's den
Light a ring of campfires at the den

quests.title: Frostmaw
text: Wake Frostmaw and defeat it without letting its ice breath freeze you to the ground.

tasks.title: Defeat Frostmaw at its den

quests.title: The Cold Heart
text: Frostmaw leaves an Ice Crystal behind, flecked with dark veins. As you pick it up, Sister Wren arrives with a letter: the veins are proof that the drain comes from deep underground.

tasks.title: Pick up the Ice Crystal Frostmaw left behind

lines: The veins match the drain. It comes from deep underground.
Find a way below, child.

tasks.title: Hear Sister Wren's news

quests.title: A Map of the Underworld
text: A cartographer sells the way below: an Alex's Caves cave map. Follow it to your first cave biome. The Underworld questline takes over there.

lines: Caves below the caves. I've charted a cabin.
Take the map. Mind the dark.
tasks.title: Buy a cave map from a cartographer
Carry the cave map
Follow the map to the underground cabin

quests.title: Roots of the Drain
text: In the Primordial Caves and the Forlorn Hollows, amber and pure darkness hum with the same dark pulse as the crystal. Gather both as proof.

tasks.title: Find the Primordial Caves
Find the Forlorn Hollows
Gather amber humming with the pulse
Gather pure darkness humming with the pulse

quests.title: Breath of the Deep
text: An ocean monument holds a warden, and you will need to breathe. Brew water breathing and night vision for the dive, and enchant a helmet for the depths.

tasks.title: Brew potions to breathe and see underwater
Bring a helmet to enchant for the depths
Set an enchanting table to prepare the helmet

quests.title: The Elder of the Sea
text: Dive into an ocean monument and defeat one of its Elder Guardians, the ocean's own warden, half drained already.

tasks.title: Dive to the ocean monument
Defeat the monument's Elder Guardian

quests.title: The Sealed Pyramid
text: Scout a Cursed Pyramid in the desert: clear its outer halls of Koboletons and defeat a Kobolediator for Ancient Metal. Copy the runes on its sealed inner door while you are there.

tasks.title: Clear the pyramid's outer halls
Defeat the Kobolediator for Ancient Metal

search.found: Runes of the Door of Seal, copied in charcoal.

tasks.title: Copy the runes on the sealed inner door

quests.title: The Frosted Prison
text: Scout a Frosted Prison in the snowy plains and defeat an Aptrgangr guarding its gate for Black Steel. The inner door is sealed and something vast sleeps behind it. Copy the runes on it too.

tasks.title: Defeat the Aptrgangr guarding the gate

search.found: Runes of the Door of Seal, frost-rimed.

tasks.title: Copy the runes on the sealed inner door

quests.title: Doors That Will Not Open
text: Bring both copies of the Door of Seal runes to the Arcane Order's librarian: eight seals, eight sleepers, and none can be broken yet.

lines: Two copies of the same seal. Eight sleepers, then.
None can be broken yet. Keep these runes safe.
tasks.title: Show the rune copies to the Arcane Order

rewards.name: Runed Tablet
lore: The Door of Seal, copied twice.

quests.title: Steel From the Sleepers
text: The guardians' metal is sound, and the sleepers will be hard to hurt. Forge a Cataclysm weapon from the Ancient Metal or Black Steel you took.

tasks.title: Forge a weapon from the guardians' metal

quests.title: The Peak Above the Clouds
text: The last Overworld warden waits at a mountaintop Monastery. Climb the peak with ParCool moves and a grappling hook before the storm closes in.

lines: The storm is closing in. Climb!

tasks.title: Climb to the Monastery before the storm

quests.title: The Sculptor
text: Climb the Sculptor's pillar trial while it reshapes the stone beneath you, then defeat it.

tasks.title: Defeat the Sculptor in its trial

quests.title: The Red Glow
text: From the peak you see a red scar on the horizon: a ruined portal. Repair or build a Nether portal and step into the Nether for the first time.

tasks.title: Gather obsidian for the portal frame
Raise the portal frame
Step into the Nether

quests.title: The Burning Realm
text: In the Nether, a lost Reece courier hides in a ruin. She saw the drain's threads running toward the fortresses.

tasks.title: Cross into the Nether
Find the ruin where the lost courier hides

encounter.name: Lost Courier
lines: Thank Notch, someone from Reece! The threads all run toward the fortresses.
Take my map.

tasks.title: Find the lost Reece courier

quests.title: Blaze and Bone
text: The drain's threads end at the fortresses. Raid a Nether fortress for blaze rods and nether wart to brew what you will need.

tasks.title: Find a Nether fortress
Fight the fortress's blazes
Take blaze rods for brewing
Take nether wart for brewing

quests.title: Eyes That See
text: The wardens' homes are hidden. Craft Eyes of Ender to find the way.

tasks.title: Craft Eyes of Ender to find the wardens' homes

quests.title: The Citadel of Flame
text: Find the Nether citadel and slip past its blazes to see the Wildfire on its throne.

tasks.title: Find the citadel of flame

lines: Blazes watch the halls. If anything burns you, they've seen you.

tasks.title: Slip past the blazes to the throne room unseen

quests.title: The Wildfire
text: Defeat the Wildfire by breaking its shields and dodging its fire waves.

tasks.title: Defeat the Wildfire on its throne

quests.title: Debris From Below
text: The deepest metal is buried deep in the Nether. Mine ancient debris, and watch your footing.

tasks.title: Mine ancient debris deep in the Nether

quests.title: The Black Smith
text: Netherite needs a template to be worked. Loot one from a bastion and upgrade your first netherite piece.

tasks.title: Find a bastion remnant
Loot a netherite upgrade template
Smelt your first netherite ingot

quests.title: The Twilight Calls (Part 2)
text: The spirits' second curse: defeat the Hydra in its fiery lair, and forge a Fiery weapon from its blood. The Twilight questline continues.

tasks.title: Defeat the Hydra in its fiery lair
Forge a Fiery weapon from its blood

quests.title: The Dead King's Crypt
text: Optional: the Arcane Order traces the drain to Iron's Catacombs and the Dead King. Reaching the catacombs opens the magic questline's chain, which holds the fight.

lines: The drain runs to the catacombs. The Dead King sleeps there.
Take this map.
tasks.title: Ask the Arcane Order where the drain leads
Reach the catacombs the Order names

quests.title: Three Black Skulls
text: The Wither needs three wither skeleton skulls. Hunt wither skeletons in fortresses. A fourth, cursed one only drops while this quest is open.

tasks.title: Hunt wither skeletons in a fortress
Hold three wither skeleton skulls

item.name: a Cursed Skull
item.tooltip: Only drops while the quest is open

tasks.title: Take a Cursed Skull

quests.title: The Wither
text: Summon the Wither far from Reece, in a pit you dig deep underground, and destroy it. The world's wardens are being turned. This one was made to be.

tasks.title: Bring soul sand for the summoning
Build the summoning in a pit far from Reece
Destroy the Wither in its pit

quests.title: A Light for Reece
text: Build a beacon on a pyramid in Reece's square so the village has a light the drain can't reach.

tasks.title: Raise a beacon on a pyramid in Reece's square

quests.title: Something Below the Chasm
text: Optional: a diver's logbook speaks of something huge circling a ruined submarine in the Abyssal Chasm. Finding the trench opens the Alex's Caves chain, which holds the Hullbreaker fight.

tasks.title: Find the trench the logbook names
Find the ruined submarine below

quests.title: Something Big Hatches
text: Optional: find a tremorsaurus egg near the primordial volcano and raise the hatchling, or fight a wild tremorsaurus.

tasks.title: Search the volcano's slopes for an egg
Raise the hatchling until it follows you

quests.title: Where the Eyes Fall
text: Throw Eyes of Ender across the land until they dive, then dig down into a stronghold.

tasks.title: Gather Eyes of Ender to throw
Follow the eyes down into a stronghold
